summary: Datacentrex, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 14, 2026, furnishing a press release under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing the installation and energization of more than 500 previously acquired ElphaPex DG2 Scrypt ASIC miners. The units were prepaid, with initial miners already online and the remainder expected to energize over coming weeks. Upon full energization, online Scrypt hashrate is expected to rise roughly 21%, from 43.2 TH/s to 52.2 TH/s, while deployed power capacity grows from about 12.5 MW to 14 MW. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply; this is a routine operational update.
